❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the Rule of 72?

A mental shortcut: years to double ≈ 72 ÷ annual rate. At 8%, money doubles in about 9 years.

How accurate is it?

Within a few percent for rates between 4% and 15%. It is an approximation of the exact ln(2)/ln(1+r) formula.

What about the Rule of 114 and 144?

Same idea: 114 ÷ rate ≈ years to triple, 144 ÷ rate ≈ years to quadruple.
